stages.label: Construct features
stages.detail: two Half C8 planes; 64 pixels each

stages.label: Half adapter
stages.detail: FP16 MMA even in the FP8 entry

stages.label: Expand + activation
stages.detail: one dense 32→128 matrix

stages.label: Contract

stages.label: Q / K / V

stages.label: Q × Kᵀ

profiles.name: global_attention_chained_c1024_fp16

stages.label: Retain Q once
stages.detail: four M16 query tiles / warp

stages.label: Stage K and V
stages.detail: ping-pong slots; reuse across 256 queries

stages.label: Q × Kᵀ
stages.detail: scores for the current 64-key tile

stages.label: Surrogate E + row sum
stages.detail: denominator uses Half E, before operand packing

stages.label: Publish E; E × V
stages.detail: accumulate numerator across all key tiles

stages.label: Tail correction + divide
stages.detail: subtract padded-key mass; publish this query slice

notes: Grid X selects one of 32 heads; Y selects a 256-query block.
At 4K: T=2160; the key traversal has 34 tiles = 2176 positions.
Q, numerator and denominator survive the entire key loop; scores do not.
